title: 静かにしてくなンしぇ

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yukino Bijin and I are heading back from an outing when we spot a mobile haunted house set up, when suddenly…
AAAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Ines?! What's with the scream'n?! Did you just come outta that haunted house?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Oh, Yukino! W-well, actually…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Ah, so you're work'n there?! And you saw a real ghost?!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Exactlyyy! That spook's going to give the guests full-blown heart attacks!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Hoo boy, I bet! …Say, I don't s'pose you could let me have a snoop around inside, could you? I might figure someth'n out!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mumble, mumble… Giggle, giggle… Rustle! Clatter!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Ooh… There's someth'n in here, no mistake 'bout that. But judg'n from those sounds, it can't be that spooky…

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Aghhhhh! It's p-p-pitch black in heeeere!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Don't worry, we'll be fine! Okay, the light switch should be around here somewhere…

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Yukinooo! Hurryyy!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Um, you don't need t'be afraid. Just 'cause there's a ghost don't mean it's up to anyth'n bad.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: The best thing t'do is just sprinkle some salt and ignore it. That's what my dad taught me, at least…

text_block_list.name: Young Yukino
text_block_list.text: Daddyyyy, what is that? It's like there's a funny voice follow'n me around.

text_block_list.name: Yukino's Father
text_block_list.text: Don't look b'hind you, Yukino. Don't answer it, either. That's no human, and it doesn't feel like no yokai or guardian spirit either.

text_block_list.name: Yukino's Father
text_block_list.text: It must be a ghost! Hahaha! But don't worry. Us liv'n people're stronger than ghosts, so you'll be fine so long as y'don't show any weakness. Y'gotta stay tough!

text_block_list.name: Young Yukino
text_block_list.text: Wowww, so that's how it works. Okay, I just gotta keep it t'gether, then! Hmph!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: So you don't need t'worry, Ines! Just be your normal cheerful self, and it'll all be fiiine!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: O-oh, okay! In that case… I'll try and pump myself up!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tug… Tug…
choice_data_list: Did something just… yank my jacket?
Did something just… yank my jacket?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Eek! Th-that wasn't me! …S-so who was it?!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Holy smokes, this's one persistent spook. Grrr… That does it!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Hey! Quit creep'n ev'ryone out already!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: You're being a pain in the butt! So stop hassl'n us!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Yay! Sounds like we got through to it! That's a relief and a half!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I've totally stopped shivering too!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Way to go, Yukino! Y-you're amazing!
choice_data_list: Ines and I should try to be tougher too.
Ines and I should try to be tougher too.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Way to go, Yukino! Y-you're amazing!
choice_data_list: Ines and I should try to be tougher too.
Ines and I should try to be tougher too.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: D-dependable? I dunno about that!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I just wasn't spooked is all. I mean, that spirit just wasn't all that scary!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Don't downplay it! You were so confident and cool! I really owe you one!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Whoa, whoa, whoa. Confident? Cool? Ehehe… You're mak'n me blush here!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: It's the truth! Okay, that's it… I'm going to take a page out of your book, Yuki!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Hey! M-Mr. Ghost! Get y'butt into the afterlife! Lick'ty-split!
choice_data_list: You're not welcome here! Get outta here, you dunderheads!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: No, hold on! You can be brave without impersonat'n me, y'know!
